highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel reads on the Skia m152 engine.
highlights_body: This release also strengthens object lifetime handling, improves package diagnostics, and adds platform assets for Nano Server and Vulkan Silk.NET consumers.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and includes its subsequent servicing, stability, and glyph-handling fixes.
Adds managed bindings for Skia's Graphite backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, expanding access to modern GPU rendering APIs.
SKImage and SKSurface gain backend-neutral RequestReadPixels APIs for asynchronous pixel readback.
Fixes use-after-free and leak paths involving SKRegion span iteration, SKPixmap subset and With* results, SKImage raster creation, and HarfBuzz blob conversion.
Resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms now disposes the previous uniform buffer instead of retaining it.
Improves hot managed operations by avoiding SKData.SaveTo buffer copies, feature-array copying during HarfBuzz shaping, tag string boxing, and repeated uniform lookups.
Adds FreeType-backed Nano Server font support, restores the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and produces Apple native symbol packages.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-backed font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Improved Windows native-build setup by initializing the MSVC environment once
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced Skia m152, Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, native-lifetime fixes, and expanded platform assets.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added the m152 servicing update, Apple native symbol packages, Vulkan Silk.NET packaging, and HarfBuzz performance and lifetime fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp avoids copying caller-provided feature arrays during shaping and fixes the non-memory-backed blob conversion lifetime path.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces Skia m152, Graphite bindings, and asynchronous pixel reads.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also adds native-lifetime fixes and expanded platform package assets.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 refines the m152 release line.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: It adds the latest upstream engine servicing changes, native symbol packages, and HarfBuzzSharp improvements.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 is the stable m152 release with Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel reads.
v4.152.0.body: It includes the validated engine, lifetime, performance, and platform improvements from the preview line.
